title: The Smugglers' Cellar
objective: Find out what has moved into the old smugglers' cellar, and clear it out.

rooms.name: Foot of the Stair
rooms.description: Worn steps end in a cold cellar passage. Water drips somewhere ahead, and the air smells of rot and lamp oil.

features.name: Rusted Lantern
features.description: A rusted lantern hangs from a hook by the stair, its glass cracked.
features.discovery: Scratched into the lantern's base: "Rats gone. Boss in the den."

rooms.name: Alcove
rooms.description: A cramped alcove cut into the rock, out of the draught. Someone slept here once.

features.name: Iron-Bound Chest
features.description: A squat iron-bound chest sits in the corner, its lock long since broken.
features.discovery: Under a mouldy blanket in the chest lies a stoppered vial of red liquid, and a silver hip flask wrapped in a rag.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Silver Hip Flask
items.description: A smuggler's hip flask of chased silver, still smelling of brandy.

rooms.name: Rat-Gnawed Cellar
rooms.description: Grain sacks slump against the walls, chewed open. Droppings cover the floor.

features.name: Gnawed Sacks
features.description: The sacks held grain once. Now they hold mostly droppings.
features.discovery: At the bottom of one sack, under the droppings, is an oilskin packet the rats could not chew through.

items.name: Smuggled Moonstone
items.description: A milky moonstone that glows faintly blue in the lamplight.

items.name: Smugglers' Cut
items.description: A smuggler's share of gold, sewn into the oilskin.

rooms.name: Smugglers' Den
rooms.description: A vaulted room with a cold hearth, a table of empty bottles and a barrel used as a desk.

features.name: Damp Ledger
features.description: A damp ledger lies open on the barrel.
features.discovery: The last entry reads: "Goods moved upriver. The goblin stays to guard the den."

passages.description: A low gap in the passage wall.

opponents.description: A goblin warrior kicks back its stool and draws a scimitar.

endings.title: The cellar is clear
endings.text: The goblin falls beside its barrel. Whatever the smugglers left behind, nothing guards it now.

endings.title: Fallen in the cellar
endings.text: You fall on the cold cellar floor. Your adventuring ends here.
